underlying_goal: Create an issue tracking skill (SKILL.md) that integrates with Plane MCP to automate issue discovery, creation, tracking, and sub-task management during development workflows
friction_detail: The user had to correct Claude multiple times: UUID-based config needed simplification to name-based, then further to minimal config, and clarification that branch-based linking is skill logic not a Plane feature.
brief_summary: User wanted to design an issue tracking skill using Plane MCP with a template and best-practice workflows; Claude produced the plan and template through multiple rounds of user-driven corrections on config complexity and feature attribution.
